newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Five injured in Brazil air force base explosion.
newsitem.headline: Five injured in Brazil air force base explosion.

text.p: Five people were seriously injured in an explosion on a Brazilian air force base in Rio de Janeiro, a spokesman for the Aviation Ministry said on Wednesday.

He said the five military personnel were defusing incendiary bombs at the Parque de Material Belico da Aeronautica airbase at Ilha do Governador in Rio de Janeiro when one of the detonators exploded on Tuesday.
The five men, who were not identified, were taken to hospital immediately in serious condition, he said.
The ministry has launched an inquiry to investigate the causes of what it described as a "regrettable work accident."
